**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in meaning of the given word.**

Peer
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Inferior'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer for the word opposite in meaning to** "Peer"** is: **Inferior.**
 
• The word "**Peer**" refers to **someone who is equal in social status, age, or abilities.** It indicates a person who belongs to the same group or level as others, often implying a sense of similarity or equality.
 
 
• For example, if two individuals are of the same age and have similar qualifications, they can be considered peers.
 
 
 
• On the other hand, "**Inferior**" is the opposite of "**Peer**." It means **lower in rank, status, quality, or ability.** When someone is referred to as inferior, it suggests that they are of a lower position or level compared to others. For instance, if one person is highly skilled and accomplished while another is less experienced and less competent, the latter can be considered inferior to the former.
 
• Now, let's examine the other options:
 
• **Equal**: This option is not the opposite of "Peer" but rather a synonym. "Equal" refers to someone or something that is the same in quantity, degree, value, or status. It indicates a sense of similarity or equivalence.
 
• Look: This option does not represent the opposite meaning of "Peer." "Look" can refer to the act of visually perceiving something or the physical appearance of someone. It does not carry an opposite meaning in relation to "Peer."
 
• **Match**: This option does not convey the opposite meaning of "Peer" either. "Match" can refer to something that corresponds or goes well with another thing. It can also refer to a competition or contest between two individuals or teams.
 
• To summarize, the correct opposite for "**Peer**" is "**Inferior**," as it denotes a lower rank or position. The other options, "Equal," "Look," and "Match," do not represent the opposite meaning of "Peer" but rather carry different meanings.

questions.question: What is the main cause of temperature rise in the interior of the Earth?

options.text: Both the pressure and breakdown of radioactive substances

questions.solution:
The main causes of temperature rise in the interior of the Earth are both the pressure and the breakdown of radioactive substances.

__
 
• The temperature of the Earth increases from the Crust to the Core. It is about 600°C at a depth of 20 Km, 1000-1500°C at 100Km and around 4000-5000°C in the Core.

 
• The heat energy released by radioactive decay of elements such as uranium and thorium accounts for about 50% of the heat given off by the Earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

The Earth's interior temperature rises primarily due to two key factors:

**Radioactive Decay:** Radioactive isotopes, such as uranium and thorium, present within the Earth's mantle, release heat energy as they decay. This ongoing process generates a significant amount of heat over geological time.

**Pressure: **At greater depths within the Earth, the immense pressure caused by the weight of overlying rocks and material compacts and compresses the matter. This compression leads to an increase in temperature, as it raises the kinetic energy of atoms and molecules.

Together, the breakdown of radioactive substances and pressure result in a gradual increase in temperature as you move deeper into the Earth. This internal heat plays a crucial role in geological processes and the Earth's overall dynamics.

questions.question:
Which of the statement(s) about the reaction given below is/are CORRECT?

2PbO (s) + C (s) ⟶ 2Pb (s) + CO₂ (g)

I. Lead is getting reduced.

II. Carbon is getting reduced.

III. Lead oxide is getting reduced.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only I and III**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Statement 1 is correct: Lead is getting reduced as it goes from an oxidation state of +2 in PbO to 0 in elemental Pb.
 
• Statement 2 is incorrect: Carbon is getting reduced (Carbon is actually oxidized, as it goes from an oxidation state of 0 in elemental carbon to +4 in CO₂).
 
• Statement 3 is correct: Lead oxide is getting reduced as lead is reduced from +2 to 0, but carbon acts as the reducing agent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reduction and Oxidation:**

 
 
• Reduction is the process where a substance gains electrons, whereas oxidation is when a substance loses electrons.
 
• In the reaction, lead oxide (PbO) undergoes reduction by gaining electrons to form solid lead (Pb).
 
• Carbon (C) is oxidized to CO2, meaning it loses electrons in the process.
 
 
 
• **Oxidizing and Reducing Agents:**
 
 
• The reducing agent is the substance that donates electrons and gets oxidized. In this case, carbon is the reducing agent.
 
• The oxidizing agent is the substance that accepts electrons and gets reduced. Lead oxide acts as the oxidizing agent in this reaction.
 
 
 
• **Lead Oxide in Metallurgy:**
 
 
• In metallurgy, the extraction of metals like lead is often achieved by reducing their oxides with carbon or other reducing agents.
 
• Lead oxide (PbO) is reduced to lead (Pb) in the reaction by carbon in a furnace or smelting process.
 
 
 
• **Common Reduction Reaction:**
 
 
• This type of reaction is a redox reaction, where reduction and oxidation happen simultaneously.
 
• The process is common in the extraction of metals, where an oxide of the metal is reduced to its pure form.

questions.question: Breaking down of fats from large globules to smaller globules by Bile juice is similar to which of the following?
questions.solution:
Breaking down of fats from large globules to smaller globules by Bile juice is similar to Emulsification of soaps.

 
• The liver secretes Bile. When bile leaves the liver, it gets stored in the gallbladder, before being released into the duodenum. When it gets released from the gallbladder, it breaks large fat globules into smaller particles, in the same way as soap breaks fat particles into small globules that are suspended in water and gets washed away. This is known as emulsification. It is important because fats are not soluble in water, yet the reaction of digestion must take place in a water solution.
 
• The process in which one liquid gets dispersed in a second immiscible liquid is called Emulsification.
 
• The cleansing action of soap is due to emulsification.

questions.question: When warm air rises up and cold air from the surrounding areas rushes in to fill its place then this sets up ________ in air.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Convection.**

**EXPLANATION:**

When warm air rises up and cold air from the surrounding areas rushes in to fill its place then this sets up convection in air.

 
• When warm air rises, the air pressure at that place gets lowered. The cold air from the surrounding areas rushes in to fill its place. This sets up convection currents in the air.
 
• Wind currents are generated due to uneven heating on the earth.
 
• Convection is the process by which the transmission of heat takes place through a substance from one point to another due to the actual bodily movement of heated particles of the substance.

questions.question: Which organization will launch two missions named GOLD and ICON to explore the ionosphere?
questions.solution:
The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) will launch two missions GOLD and ICON to explore the ionosphere.

 
• With these two missions, NASA will explore the ionosphere, located 96 km above Earth’s surface.
 
• The Global-scale Observations of the Limb and Disk (GOLD) mission will be launched in January 2018, while the Ionospheric Connection Explorer (ICON) will be launched later this year.
 
• NASA stated that both the missions were complementary to each other. GOLD will be in a geostationary orbit over the Western Hemisphere, about 35,398 km above the planet’s surface while the ICON will be in low-Earth orbit, at 560 km above Earth, like a close-up camera.
 
• Both the missions will also help to measure how upper atmosphere changes in response to hurricanes and geomagnetic storms.
